name: Thaumaturgical Rituals (Sabbat) — 1 Basic — Recure of the Homeland

system.description: Mix a handful of earth from your mortal birthplace with two of your own Blood Traits to create a curative paste. Applying or consuming a dose instantly heals one level of aggravated damage, but only the caster may benefit, and no more than one Health Level may be healed this way per night.
